title: The Failure at God School Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
A new official website opened on Friday to announce that author Hyuganatsu and artist Modomu Akagawara 's The Failure at God School ( Kami-sama Gakkō no Ochikobore ) manga is getting a television anime. The website unveiled a visual:

Artist Akagawara also shared an illustration to commemorate the announcement:

Yen Press licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Modern life means modern solutions—even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers. Any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of god. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother isn't looking promising. But if Nagi isn't careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for...

Hyuganatsu ( The Apothecary Diaries ) and Akagawara debuted the manga in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine in August 2021. Hakusensha published the manga's 15th compiled book volume on Friday. The novel adaptation launched in January 2022. Star Seas Company published the novels' fifth volume in Japan on May 27.

Hyuganatsu began serializing The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Touko Shino in August 2014. The novels have inspired a manga and an anime adaptation .
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Author's The Failure at God School Manga Gets Anime Adaptation
content:
The Failure at God School supernatural shojo manga by Natsu Hyuga ( The Apothecary Diaries creator) and Modomu Akagawara is officially getting a TV anime adaptation.

The story takes place in modern Japan, where people with supernatural abilities can qualify to serve as gods at shrines. It follows Nagi, a girl who believes she has no powers of her own. After she uses a technique developed to block her telepathic twin brother to fend off an attack, she discovers that she possesses supernatural abilities and is enrolled in a school that trains future gods.

The two creators commented:

Natsu Hyuga (story):

“The Failure at God School is getting an anime adaptation. We’ll get to see and hear Nagi, Takeru, Tsukuyomi and Tota move and speak. What a wonderful thing. It’s all thanks to everyone involved in making the series and to its readers. To my past self, who started writing after an editor told me, ‘It’s for Hana to Yume, and Akagawara-sensei will be drawing the manga’: It’s getting an anime! I suppose all I can do now is keep writing the story and pray to the gods. Thank you for your support.”

Modomu Akagawara (art):

“Thank you for the TV anime adaptation of The Failure at God School! As the manga artist in charge of the comic version, I couldn’t be happier. I’m filled with gratitude toward original author Natsu Hyuga, our editors, the anime production team, everyone who has helped us, and all the readers who have supported the series. I’m also looking forward to seeing the characters of the school for gods come to life and speak, as a viewer myself!”

A teaser visual was also revealed:

The Failure at God School began serialization in Hakusensha’s Hana to Yume magazine in August 2021. Yen Press publishes the manga in English, describing the story of Volume 1: Nagi’s normal! Gods are supposed to give girls like her divine aid, not invitations to the most prestigious magic academy in Japan!! Modern life means modern solutions, even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers—any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of God. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother doesn’t look promising. But if Nagi isn’t careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for…

The Apothecary Diaries has numerous upcoming projects, including Season 3 of the TV anime , an anime film , the first console game , and a live-action series .
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Gakkou no Ochikobore' Gets TV Anime
content:
Production company Bandai Namco Filmworks opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Natsu Hyuuga 's Kamisama Gakkou no Ochikobore ( The Failure at God School ) manga on Friday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).

Hyuuga and Modomu Akagawara began serializing the shoujo manga in Hana to Yume magazine in August 2021. Hakusensha published the 14th volume on May 20, with the 15th volume scheduled for September 18. The series has over 1.7 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

A light novel adaptation by Hyuuga, featuring illustrations by Akagawara, began publication under Kodansha's Seikaisha Fictions imprint in January 2022. The fifth volume was released in May 2025.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in August 2024. The third volume was released on February 24, with the fourth volume scheduled for September 22.

Synopsis Modern life means modern solutions—even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers. Any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of god. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother isn't looking promising. But if Nagi isn't careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for… (Source: Yen Press)

title: Takeshobo to Release 3 BL Manga Titles Digitally in English
content:
Publisher Takeshobo announced on Thursday that it will release three boys love manga titles digitally in English:

Title: A Man Who Never Says No ( Kobamanai Otoko ) Creator: Emi Mitsuki Release Date: September 18 Summary: Ritsu Shiraishi is a super capable hotel concierge who helps private detective Kurose out of personal interest. One day, while investigating a politician's affair, Kurose discovers that Ritsu regularly meets the politician. Driven by jealousy and anger, Kurose tries to sleep with him, but finds that Ritsu also likes Kurose. So they are in love with each other. But is it a mere coincidence? It seems like Ritsu is keeping a lot more secrets...

Title: A Golden Someday ( Kiniro no Itsuka ) Creator: Emi Mitsuki Release Date: September 25 (volume 1) Summary: In this spin-off of " A Man Who Never Says No ", Yamabuki, a childhood friend of Ritsu's appears and he is spending miserable days. He gets into trouble with his friend with benefits and the bad manager of the restaurant where he works part-time. Out of desperation, he tries to have an affair with a handsome man who talks to him at the restaurant, but the man, Murasaki, says he is a detective and asks Yamabuki to cooperate with him for a certain investigation, saying “This could be your fresh start.” The subject of the investigation that Murasaki has brought up is the super concierge, Ritsu Shiraishi...

Title: Enveloped by the Fever of Guilt ( Yamashisa no Netsu Dakareta ) Creator: Unohana Release Date: October 2026 (volumes 1-2) Summary: Amachi is a pharmaceutical rep who has been working in Germany for two years. Before returning to Japan, he visits a Christmas market to create some memories. There, he sees a handsome man holding a large stuffed toy. As he is Amachi's type, Amachi talks to him and they agree to meet the next day. They go on a date and the guy, Okumura, hits on Amachi directly. They spend a few days together as temporary lovers. But Amachi has a strange feeling. It seems that he already knows him. When Amachi finds out that Okumura is a neurosurgeon, their relationship begins to go awry... This is a complete two-volume series.

Takeshobo will release the manga in English digitally on the following platforms: Renta! , MangaPlaza , Coolmic , BookWalker , and Rakuten Kobo.

title: A Mark Against Thee Webtoon Gets Stage Musical Adaptation
content:
Live Contents Group announced on September 15 the A Mark Against Thee webtoon is being adapted into a stage musical, with a full-length reading showcase scheduled for October 5 at Seoul's Sowol Art Hall.

The production was selected for the 2026 Large-Scale Musical Reading Performance Support Program, following an earlier first-act reading showcase in 2024.

Serialized between 2019 and 2021, the original webtoon was created by gotaeho.

The story of the webtoon, which has accumulated more than 100 million views around the globe, reads:

Innocent man framed for murder and sentenced to death. Released 17 years later after his name was cleared. The times have changed. Yeop has changed. His friends and family have changed. Nothing is the same anymore. The harsh reality surrounding him turned Yeop from a grateful young man to a stoic, skeptical person. And now, he wants to exact revenge on everything that worked together to ruin his life.

The original webtoon is also being adapted into a film directed by Young-joo Byun, starring Jung-min Park and Hyun-jung Go.

Fans can read the official English version of the webtoon on WEBTOON .
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Biggest Sports Hit Returns With Big Screen Plans
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s anime studio, MAPPA , has emerged as one of the biggest studios in the anime industry, with fandoms, especially shonen fans, hoping for their new anime to be animated by the studio. The studio has developed this reputation thanks to anime like Jujutsu Kaisen and Chainsaw Man , and it continues to emerge as a leading studio in the industry. However, MAPPA wasn’t always a big studio, and while it was still finding its footing, it adapted many great anime, which also included one of its early original anime, Yuri!!! on Ice . This anime debuted in October 2016 and became a critically acclaimed original sports anime series.

It depicted a sport that no one was talking about, yet it gave fans the feel of everything they could have come to expect from a sports manga series. Ten years later, the anime is still one of the most memorable sports anime series , and fans are still hoping that it will be ignited once again with a comeback, much like Yuri, the protagonist, did in the anime. While that is yet to be seen, the anime is going to celebrate its 10th anniversary, with one major plan including its return to the big screen on October 19, as the first five episodes of the anime will be presented as a movie during Crunchyroll Anime Nights.

MAPPA’s Yuri!!! on Ice Celebrates Its 10th Anniversary on the Big Screen

The details for where fans can find Yuri!!! on Ice ‘s return on the big screen have been posted by Regal , where fans can find theaters near their location, but only fans in the United States and Canada will be able to watch it, as these theaters are limited to featuring the movie for only one day on October 19. The runtime of the movie is almost two hours, which will serve as a compiled version of the anime’s first five episodes. This announcement was something that fans weren’t hoping for, but with anime getting re-edited into movies becoming a perfect trend, this is something the anime could have hopped on. That said, the expectations fans had for the 10th anniversary were much higher.

Ever since the anime’s prequel was canceled, everyone had given up, but since the Crunchyroll Anime Awards, the anime has been showcasing signs of returning. It started with the award function featuring a performance by Dean Fujioka of the opening theme, “History Maker,” and soon after, the Yuri!!! on Ice official X account getting verified and unpinning the cancellation announcement of the prequel anime two years after its announcement . These signs implied that the anime perhaps was returning after all, and the 10th anniversary would have been the best occasion.

But that hope seems to have been crushed, as the 10th anniversary plan is instead the anime’s return to the big screen. Nevertheless, this will serve as the perfect nostalgic release for fans, once again reminding them of the masterpiece original sports anime that Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s studio created, and it might reunite the fans to raise their voices for the anime’s return, which perhaps MAPPA Studio could announce after the 10th anniversary.

title: Nobuhiko Okamoto Joins Bless Anime's Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed on Thursday that Nobuhiko Okamoto has joined the anime's cast as Ginga Yoyogi.

The anime will star Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa and Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki.

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha will publish the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.
author: ANN

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha will publish the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.
Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.
The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.

title: Netmarble Reveals Bloomwalker Game is Part of Ni no Kuni Universe in New Trailer
content:
The "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday revealed a new trailer for Netmarble 's Bloomwalker game, which reveals the game is part of the Ni no Kuni universe. Netmarble additionally revealed the game will launch for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam .

English version

Japanese version

Netmarble first announced the game as "Project Bloomwalker" in August 2025. Netmarble Neo is developing the game.

Netmarble describes the "cozy crafting adventure" game that takes place in the fallen world of Luminoa:

Set in a once-beautiful land shared by humans and mysterious spirits, the game begins when a mysterious meteor crashes down that leaves an impact site so polluted that no life can survive. As the world suffers, Bloomwalkers appear who can wield power to restore life and heal the wounded earth. Taking on the role of a Bloomwalker, players will journey forth in their unique moving house to cleanse the polluted landscapes and rekindle the harmony of nature.

The game will feature a moving house system, and players will travel with the house to cleanse the pollution spreading across the land.

Netmarble previously developed the Ni no Kuni : Cross Worlds smartphone game , which debuted in Japan in June 2021, and launched worldwide in May 2022.

Level 5 debuted the fantasy role-playing game Ni no Kuni : Wrath of the White Witch for the PlayStation 3 in Japan in 2011, after a Ni no Kuni : Shikkoku no Madōshi game for Nintendo DS in 2010 and a game for Japanese phones. Namco Bandai Games then released Ni no Kuni : Wrath of the White Witch outside Japan in 2013. The RPG features cut scenes from Studio Ghibli .

A remastered version of Ni no Kuni : Wrath of the White Witch launched for PlayStation 4 and PC in September 2019, and the original Ni no Kuni : Wrath of the White Witch game's Switch version launched on the same day.

Level 5 released the Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom PS4 and PC game worldwide in March 2018. Level 5 released the game on Switch in September 2021, and for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S in March 2023.

The franchise inspired an anime film that opened in Japan in August 2019.

title: Atelier Karia Game Streams Character Video for Rutger, Lenja
content:
Koei Tecmo started streaming a new character video for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories , a new game in its Atelier franchise , during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday. The video features Rutger voiced by Jun Fukuyama , and Lenja voiced by Yoshino Aoyama , both returning characters from the Atelier Yumia game. The video also features Yumia voiced by Wakana Kuramochi .

The game will launch on February 25 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .

The company describes the game:

Reawaken the past, savor the present. A vast fantasy alchemy RPG of memories and discovery. This entry in the Atelier series focuses on tying in alchemy to deepen every aspect of the game. Synthesized items can now be used for more than just combat. They will assist you during exploration and base-building, and will help shape the very path of your adventure. Karia can also eat synthesized items to change both her appearance and abilities. Synthesize items, use them on your adventure, and eat them. This cycle will tie everything together in this new evolution of the Atelier series.

The Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian ( Kurenai no Renkinjutsushi to Shiro no Shugosha: Resleriana no Atelier ) game launched in the West for PS5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in September 2025. The game launched for the same systems plus PlayStation 4 in Japan on the same day.
author: ANN
